Based on the context provided, the new exported function is **`fileNeuronArticleId`** (file-neuron.ts).

It computes the persisted article ID for a file-neuron — the same ID format used in the FTS index — rather than using the logical graph ID (file:<relPath>). This allows `resolveExistingInbound` to correctly look up the file-neuron by matching the persisted ID stored in the index, fixing the mismatch that was preventing conversation-derived decisions and bugs from attaching to the target file-neuron.
